sentences.en: Greenpeace is fighting an uphill battle to save the environment.
sentences.zh: 绿色和平组织在拯救环境方面面临着一场艰苦卓绝的战斗。

sentences.en: You can win all the battles yet lose the war.
sentences.zh: 你可以赢得所有的小战役却输掉整个战争。

sentences.en: It seems that much damage was done by yesterday's battle.
sentences.zh: 看来昨天的争斗造成了很大的破坏。
